Name: Daily Screenshot
Author: CompSciLauren
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fy2JD15h/example-farm.gif[/img]

This is an example of what you can do with this mod. You can customize the quality and size. By taking a daily screenshot, eventually you'll have enough images to create a GIF that shows a time-lapse of your farm as you progress through the game!

[b][size=6]Features[/size]﻿[/b]
[list]
[*]One screenshot is automatically taken of your entire farm every day as soon as you leave your house.[/*]
[*]Easy to gather screenshots to create a GIF that shows how your farm changes over time! GIF makers can be found online, such as [url=https://ezgif.com/maker]ezgif GIF maker[/url]. Here is an [url=https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod/blob/3.1.0/Images/example1.gif]example[/url].[/*]
[*]Customizable! Change any number of default settings based on your preferences. Examples:
[list]
[*]What time of day to take screenshot.[/*]
[*]How often to take screenshot (e.g. daily, weekly, or monthly).[/*]
[*]Keyboard shortcut that takes screenshot when pressed (set to "None" by default).[/*]
[*]What weather conditions are allowed. It is common to allow all except rainy/stormy days, but default option allows all weather.[/*]
[*]Add multiple sets of rules (common example: 1 set for daily automatic screenshots, 1 for manual key-press screenshots).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]"Generic Mod Config Menu" mod[/url], which adds an in-game UI for easily updating the config (no need to edit the JSON manually).[/*]
[*]Screenshots are sent to your StardewValley/Screenshots folder, with each save file getting its own "FarmName-Screenshots" folder. Screenshots between multiple save files will not get mixed up.[/*]
[*]Easily access the screenshots in-game by scrolling to the bottom of the "Options" tab in the menu and clicking the "Open Destination Folder" button.[/*]
[*]Keeps the screenshots in the correct order to make creating the GIF easier. This is achieved by naming each screenshot with a "year-season-day.png" numerical format. For example, on Year 1, Winter, Day 3, the screenshot would be named "01-04-03.png".[/*]
[*]Translations available for the following languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Chinese. Korean coming soon. All text will be translated if your in-game language is set to any of those listed.[/*]
[/list]

[size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods. (recommended, but optional)[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 or later on Linux/Mac/Windows[/*]
[*]Works in both single player and multiplayer.[/*]
[*]No known mod conflicts.[/*]
[*]Works with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[size=6][b]Config
[/b][/size]See step 2 of "Installation" section above - highly recommend using the Generic Mod Config Menu! This will let you edit the mod settings from within the game on a user-friendly screen. If you'd rather edit the JSON directly, continue reading this section.
﻿
After you launch the game with this mod for the first time, a JSON file will be created with default mod settings. It can be edited directly. For detailed information about how the Config options work, see the [url=https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod]source code[/url]﻿ readme page. If you still have questions after reading that, please let me know! (You can post a comment on this mod page or message me on Discord - username is "compscilauren").

This is a common example of how you might setup your config.json file. The first object in "SnapshotRules" is for a daily screenshot of your farm at the start of each day. The second object is for a manual shortcut to take a screenshot every time you press the letter "P" on your keyboard.

[code]{
  "AuditoryEffects": true,
  "VisualEffects": true,
  "ScreenshotNotifications": true,
  "SnapshotRules": [
    {
      "Name": "Daily Farm Picture",
      "ZoomLevel": 0.25,
      "Directory": "Default",
      "FileName": "Default",
      "Trigger": {
        "Days": "Daily",
        "Weather": "Any",
        "Location": "Farm",
        "Key": "None",
        "StartTime": 600,
        "EndTime": 2600
      }
    },
    {
      "Name": "Keypress Picture",
      "ZoomLevel": 1.0,
      "Directory": "/home/hailey/SDV",
      "FileName": "None",
      "Trigger": {
        "Days": "Daily",
        "Weather": "Any",
        "Location": "Any",
        "Key": "P",
        "StartTime": 600,
        "EndTime": 2600
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
More examples of customizing the config.json file are available on the [url=https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod/wiki/Examples-for-config.json-file]GitHub Wiki[/url].
